name: Contract modification dispute based on emails
description: Emails suggest modification while contract formalist persona pressures integration and written-change clauses.

documents.text: Section 14: No modification is effective unless in a writing signed by both parties. Section 15: This agreement is integrated.
The draft argues the parties clearly modified the delivery deadline by email.
